missing_information_behavior: Do not make a strong efficacy claim or recommend a product without clarifying formulation, dose, evidence quality and allergies.
safety_exclusions: Do not promise wrinkle reduction, anti-aging or clinically meaningful skin outcomes.
Do not generalize findings across collagen peptides, sources and formulations.
Do not ignore fish, bovine or other source allergies.
professional_escalation_conditions: Significant skin disease, unexplained skin changes, pregnancy/lactation or relevant allergies.
population_and_context: People considering oral collagen products for skin health; evidence varies by formulation, outcome and study quality, with potential sponsorship bias.
dose_constraints: No dose from this rule. Do not infer a standardized effective dose across products; review exact formulation and evidence.
certainty_and_limitations: The cited 2025 meta-analysis requires critical appraisal for heterogeneity, funding and risk of bias before claims are approved. This justification remains draft pending source passage verification, critical appraisal, certainty assessment and professional review.
